summary: Iter 231m draft_pick_actions.py extraction backend regression — ALL GREEN. 71/71 tests passed across 11 test files (7 guard suite + 41 prior-iter regression + 19 live end-to-end + 4 archived-draft guards). Live smoke against deployed backend confirms all 5 extracted endpoints (POST /pick, POST /undo, PATCH /picks/{overall}, POST /pause, POST /seed-picks) are wired and returning 401/422 (auth/validation), not 404/405 — proving routes load without ImportError/NameError. Late-binding pattern (`from routes import drafts as _drafts` inside `_early_start_clock_msg_fn` / `_seed_draft_picks_for_draft_fn`) successfully breaks the server→drafts→draft_pick_actions→drafts import cycle. drafts.py confirmed at 1952 lines (<2000 ceiling). Real production traffic in backend.out.log shows POST /api/drafts/{id}/pick returning 200 OK from active users — make-pick endpoint working end-to-end in live use.

minor.issue: 4 file-introspection tests marked @pytest.mark.asyncio but are sync — emits PytestWarning. Not a failure, harmless. Remove the asyncio marker on these 4 tests.

critical_code_review_comments: Late-binding pattern in routes/draft_pick_actions.py (_early_start_clock_msg_fn, _seed_draft_picks_for_draft_fn) is the correct fix for the circular-import scenario, but it's a code smell that signals the underlying coupling between drafts.py helpers and the extracted modules is still tight. Future refactor: extract `_perform_one_auto_pick`, `_seed_draft_picks_for_draft`, `_early_start_clock_msg` into a `routes/draft_helpers.py` (or `services/draft_engine.py`) so both drafts.py and draft_pick_actions.py can import from it without late binding. This also removes the indirect dependency from routes/admin_user_actions.py back into drafts.py.

drafts.py at 1952 lines is now under the 2000-line ratchet but still large; the decomposition campaign should continue (next candidates: roster/lineup endpoints, draft setup/config endpoints, autodraft loop).
